search_text: published ZDI-06-024 ZDI-CAN-052 eIQnetworks Enterprise Security Analyzer License Manager Buffer Overflow 2006-07-25 CVE-2006-3838 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2006-3838 ['eIQnetworks'] ['Enterprise Security Analyzer'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of eIQnetworks Enterprise Security Analyzer.
